description: Classified by reading packages/server/src/providers/claude.ts. mapped = the provider translates it into the casm protocol element named in `to`.

block:advisor_tool_result.note: Server-tool result block; normalize() only reads text/thinking/tool_use, so it is dropped.

block:bash_code_execution_tool_result.reason: API code-execution server tool; Claude Code runs its own Bash tool (a tool_use) instead.

block:code_execution_tool_result.reason: API code-execution server tool; Claude Code does not enable it.

block:compaction.note: Compaction summary block is dropped; no notice like Codex/pi get.

block:container_upload.reason: API code-execution container upload; Claude Code does not enable it.

block:document.note: PDF/document input is not representable: Item.user is text only and agent.send takes text only.

block:fallback.note: Model fallback marker is dropped; the user doesn't see that another model answered.

block:image.note: User images become the text "[image]"; tool_result images become "[image]". No image content in Item or agent.send.

block:mcp_tool_listing.reason: API-side MCP connector block; Claude Code is the MCP client, so MCP calls arrive as tool_use (mcp__server__tool).

block:mcp_tool_result.reason: API-side MCP connector block; Claude Code reports MCP results as tool_result.

block:mcp_tool_use.reason: API-side MCP connector block; Claude Code reports MCP calls as tool_use.

block:redacted_thinking.reason: Encrypted reasoning with nothing to display.

block:search_result.note: Inside tool results it is flattened to "[search_result]".

block:server_tool_use.note: Server-side web search/fetch calls are dropped; only client tool_use becomes Item.tool.

block:text_editor_code_execution_tool_re.reason: API code-execution server tool; Claude Code edits files with its own Edit/Write tools.

block:tool_result.note: Completes the tool item (status done/error, output text truncated to 8000 chars; non-text parts become [type]).

block:tool_search_tool_result.note: Server tool-search result block is dropped.

callback:canUseTool.note: AskUserQuestion is routed to AgentEvent.question instead.

callback:onUserDialog.note: Being implemented by another agent; counted as mapped per the coverage brief.

hook:ConfigChange.reason: Host hook callbacks are for programmatic policy. casm passes no `hooks`; the user's own hooks still run from their Claude settings files.

hook:Elicitation.reason: Host hook callback; elicitations reach casm through onElicitation.

hook:Notification.reason: Host hook callback; notifications also arrive as system/notification messages.

hook:PermissionRequest.reason: Host hook callback; permission prompts reach casm through canUseTool.

hook:PostToolUse.reason: Host hook callback; tool results arrive as tool_result blocks.

hook:PostToolUseFailure.reason: Host hook callback; failures arrive as tool_result with is_error.

hook:PreToolUse.reason: Host hook callback; casm gates tools through canUseTool.

hook:Stop.reason: Host hook callback; turn ends arrive as result messages.

query:accountInfo.reason: Agent login and accounts are set up on the host by the user; casm doesn't manage agent auth.

query:applyFlagSettings.reason: Rewrites Claude's settings layers; casm configures agents only through AgentConfig.

query:backgroundTasks.note: Background tasks (shells, subagents) are not listed or controllable.

query:getContextUsage.note: No context-window usage in the protocol.

query:initializationResult.note: Slash commands, agents, output styles and account info from init are not exposed.

query:mcpServerStatus.note: No MCP server status in the protocol.

query:readFile.reason: Remote-sidebar file reads: agents run on the host, so casm doesn't proxy the filesystem.

query:reinitialize.note: Fresh init result (commands, models) not exposed; see initializationResult.

query:reloadOutputStyles.note: A new process re-reads output styles; there is no in-place reload.

query:reloadPlugins.note: A new process re-reads plugins; there is no in-place reload.

query:reloadSkills.note: A new process re-reads skills; there is no in-place reload.

query:rewindFiles.note: No checkpoint rewind (file checkpointing isn't enabled either).

query:seedReadState.reason: Editor-integration hook for files the host already showed; casm doesn't proxy the filesystem.

query:setMaxThinkingTokens.note: Applied when the session is (re)opened, not live mid-session.

query:setMcpServers.note: Applied when the session is (re)opened, not live.

query:setModel.note: agent.update + agent.reload; not a live switch inside a turn.

query:setPermissionMode.note: agent.update + agent.reload; not live (e.g. leaving plan mode mid-turn).

query:stopTask.note: Background tasks can't be stopped individually.

query:streamInput.note: casm feeds the prompt AsyncIterable instead of calling streamInput.

query:supportedCommands.note: Slash commands/skills are not listed for clients (no autocomplete).

query:updateSettings.reason: Writes Claude settings files; casm configures agents only through AgentConfig.

query:usage_EXPERIMENTAL_MAY_CHANGE_DO_N.note: Experimental usage API; no usage in the protocol.

sdkmessage:auth_status.reason: Interactive login progress; agent auth is set up on the host by the user.

sdkmessage:conversation_reset.note: After /clear or plan-mode exit Claude starts a new conversation id; casm keeps the old nativeSessionId and transcript.

sdkmessage:prompt_suggestion.note: Predicted next prompt (opt-in promptSuggestions, not enabled).

sdkmessage:result/error_during_execution.note: outcome interrupted (after agent.interrupt) or failed with errors joined.

sdkmessage:result/success.note: Usage, cost and duration on the result are dropped (see usage gaps).

sdkmessage:system/api_retry.note: API retries are invisible; the turn just looks slow.

sdkmessage:system/background_tasks_chang.note: Background task list is not surfaced.

sdkmessage:system/commands_changed.note: Slash command list is not surfaced.

sdkmessage:system/compact_boundary.note: No compaction notice (Codex and pi produce Item.notice).

sdkmessage:system/control_request_progre.reason: Progress of client-originated side_question control requests, which casm never sends.

sdkmessage:system/elicitation_complete.note: URL-mode elicitation completion doesn't resolve the pending question; the user must confirm by hand.

sdkmessage:system/files_persisted.reason: Files API uploads for remote sessions; casm runs agents locally.

sdkmessage:system/hook_progress.reason: Hook output is opt-in (includeHookEvents, off); hooks run inside Claude.

sdkmessage:system/hook_response.reason: Hook output is opt-in (includeHookEvents, off); hooks run inside Claude.

sdkmessage:system/hook_started.reason: Hook output is opt-in (includeHookEvents, off); hooks run inside Claude.

sdkmessage:system/informational.note: Status banners (hook block reasons, command output) could be Item.notice but are dropped.

sdkmessage:system/init.note: Only session_id is read; model, tools, slash commands and MCP status are dropped.

sdkmessage:system/mirror_error.reason: Only with a SessionStore, which casm doesn't use (Claude's own JSONL is the store).

sdkmessage:system/model_refusal_fallback.note: Refusal + fallback model retry is not shown.

sdkmessage:system/model_refusal_no_fallb.note: Refusal is not shown beyond the result.

sdkmessage:system/permission_denied.note: Auto-denials (rules, auto/dontAsk mode) are not shown as such; the tool item just ends in error.

sdkmessage:system/plugin_install.reason: Headless plugin install progress (CLAUDE_CODE_SYNC_PLUGIN_INSTALL), not used by casm.

sdkmessage:system/session_state_changed.note: casm derives idle from result; background work after result isn't reflected in AgentStatus.

sdkmessage:system/task_notification.note: Background task/subagent completion is not shown.

sdkmessage:system/task_progress.note: Subagent progress is not shown; subagent messages are skipped.

sdkmessage:system/task_started.note: Background task start is not shown.

sdkmessage:system/task_updated.note: Background task updates are not shown.

sdkmessage:system/thinking_tokens.note: Live thinking progress estimate is dropped.

sdkmessage:system/worker_shutting_down.reason: Emitted by the remote bridge worker only; casm runs the CLI locally.

sdkmessage:tool_progress.note: Long-running tool progress (elapsed time) is not shown.

sdkmessage:user.note: Live: only tool_result messages (prompts are emitted by casm). History: Item.user.

streamdelta:input_json_delta.note: Tool input isn't streamed; the tool appears when the assistant message completes.

streamdelta:signature_delta.reason: Cryptographic signature of a thinking block; nothing to display.

streamevent:content_block_start.reason: Stream framing: the full assistant message replaces the delta draft.

streamevent:content_block_stop.reason: Stream framing: the full assistant message replaces the delta draft.

streamevent:message_delta.note: Carries live usage and stop_reason; dropped.

streamevent:message_start.reason: Stream framing: the full assistant message follows.

streamevent:message_stop.reason: Stream framing: the full assistant message follows.
